description: The HR Agent assists with HR operations by providing information on public holidays, calculating working days, checking current time in various time zones, and retrieving country information.
name: hr-agent

skills.description: Look up public holidays for any country and year
examples: What are the public holidays in Germany for 2025?
skills.name: Public Holidays

skills.description: Calculate business days between dates, accounting for holidays
examples: How many working days between Jan 1 and Mar 31 in the US?
skills.name: Working Days Calculator

skills.description: Check current time in any timezone for scheduling across offices
examples: What time is it in Tokyo right now?
skills.name: World Clock
